title: System drain down.
officialText:
Hydronic piping systems shall be designed and installed to permit the system to be drained. Where the
system drains to the plumbing drainage system, the installation shall conform to the requirements of the New York City Plumbing
Code.
Exception: The buried portions of systems embedded underground.
